Up. 1. 5. 1</ls>. .²7 One of the seven worlds; {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} the region above the world called जनस्. .²8 The month of religious austerities. .²9 A long period of time, Kalpa. .²10 (In <ab>astrol.</ab>) The ninth lunar mansion. .²11 Chastisement (दण्ड); आयुः शक्तिं च कालं च निर्दिश्य तप आदिशेत् <ls>Mb. 12. 267. 35</ls>. --{%m.%} .²1 The month of Māgha; तपसि मन्दगभस्तिरभीषुमान् <ls>Śi. 6. 63</ls>. .²2 An epithet of Agni. --{%m., n.%} .²1 The cold season; (शिशिर). .²2 The winter (हेमन्त). .²3 The hot season (ग्रीष्म).
